fusions.name: Tongue-Quick Thrust
fusions.desc: A sudden full-length thrust at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Splash Ring
fusions.desc: Spins the blade low, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and leaving each [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Long-Tongued Reach
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Coiled Between Cuts
fusions.desc: Every critical hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
